name: Velaa Private Island
insider_take: This ultra-exclusive private island resort in the Maldives redefines luxury with its own championship golf course designed by José María Olazábal – the only one of its kind in the entire archipelago.
whats_special: Velaa Private Island spans 47 acres of pristine paradise with just 47 villas and residences, ensuring ultimate privacy. The resort features the Maldives' first and only golf course, a state-of-the-art spa built over crystal-clear lagoons, and exclusive access to some of the world's most vibrant coral reefs just steps from your villa.
pro_tip: Book the Romantic Pool Residence for direct lagoon access and your own private stretch of beach – perfect for sunset dinners prepared by your dedicated villa chef.
dont_miss: The underwater wine cellar experience at Aragu restaurant, where you can dine surrounded by tropical fish, and the resort's signature "Velaa Experience" – a private sandbank picnic accessible only by seaplane with 360-degree ocean views.
pros: Ultimate privacy on exclusive private island resort
World-class amenities including championship golf course
Pristine Maldivian waters perfect for diving and water sports
Luxurious overwater and beachfront villa accommodations
cons: Ultra-luxury pricing reflects exclusive private island experience
Remote location requires seaplane transfer from Malé
